verified_invariants: The miss publishes the exact BF16 backing without copying bytes on this same-filesystem run.
After publication the active cache routes prefix pages through a read-only ColdStore and uses a distinct mutable ColdStore for suffix pages.
The hit reopens the same published prefix as immutable authority and reports zero copied bytes.
The conversion worker sequence restarts for the independent suffix store; the full Rust test suite exercises committing suffix pages after promotion.
fallback: If hard-link publication is unavailable, the implementation copies explicitly, reports the copied byte count and still separates the immutable prefix from the mutable suffix.
limitations: One generated token is sufficient for cache publication and reuse, but not for answer-quality comparison.
